annotation.title_clean: Regulations Amending the Canadian Aviation Regulations (RPAS – Beyond Visual Line-of-Sight and Other Operations): SOR/2025-70
annotation.title_en: Regulations Amending the Canadian Aviation Regulations (RPAS – Beyond Visual Line-of-Sight and Other Operations): SOR/2025-70
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Governor General in Council on recommendation of the Minister of Transport (Transport Canada); Canada Gazette Part II
annotation.venue: Canada Gazette, Part II, Vol. 159, No. 7
annotation.summary_en: Canadian regulations (SOR/2025-70) amending the Canadian Aviation Regulations to enable beyond-visual-line-of-sight drone operations. They add medium RPAS, level 1 complex operations, RPAS operator certificates, manufacturer declarations against Standard 922, drone registration, SFOC complexity tiers, fees and administrative monetary penalties.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates Level 1 Complex Operations pilot certificate and RPAS operator certificate for BVLOS flights
Manufacturer declarations against Standard 922 technical requirements, with acceptance letters and service difficulty reporting
Mandatory drone registration for aircraft of 250 g or more; Canadian-only commercial air service limits
Tiered SFOC complexity (very low to high) with new fees and service standards
61 new requirements enforceable by administrative monetary penalties; anti-collision lights and airspace restrictions
